qgis_project_file.description: Absolute path to a default QGIS project file (.qgs or .qgz) to serve when no project is specified in the request. Leave empty to require explicit project parameter.

cache_directory.description: Directory for QGIS Server cache files (rendered maps, tile caches, etc.). Ensure web server user has read/write access.

cache_size_mb.description: Maximum cache size in megabytes. Set to 0 for unlimited. QGIS Server automatically evicts least-recently-used items when limit is exceeded.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0=none, 1=error, 2=warning, 3=info, 4=debug. Use higher levels for troubleshooting.

parallel_rendering.description: Enable parallel rendering of map layers to improve performance on multi-core systems.

max_threads.description: Maximum number of rendering threads to use when parallel rendering is enabled. Adjust based on available CPU cores.

auth_database_path.description: Path to SQLite database used for QGIS Server authentication and authorization (if using QGIS auth plugin system).

extra_env.description: Optional list of additional environment variables for advanced configuration (e.g., custom plugin paths, project templates). Each entry maps a variable name to its value.

var_name.description: Name of the environment variable (must be valid shell variable name, e.g., QGIS_SERVER_PLUGIN_PATH).
